raw: {"title":"平抛与斜抛运动通用模型","domain":"projectile","model_js":"globalThis.coursewareModel=Object.freeze({sample(input){const s=input.scenario||{};const g=+s.g_m_s2||0;const m=+s.mass_kg||0;const v0=+s.speed_m_s||0;const x0=+s.x0_m||0;const y0=+s.y0_m||0;const theta=(+s.angle_deg||0)*Math.PI/180;const mode=s.mode||'oblique';const vx0=mode==='horizontal'?v0:v0*Math.cos(theta);const vy0=mode==='horizontal'?0:v0*Math.sin(theta);const ax=0;const ay=-g;let flightTime=0;if(g!==0){const a=-0.5*g;const b=vy0;const c=y0;const disc=b*b-4*a*c;if(disc>=0){const sd=Math.sqrt(disc);const t1=(-b+sd)/(2*a);const t2=(-b-sd)/(2*a);const ps=[t1,t2].filter(t=>t>0);if(ps.length)flightTime=Math.max.apply(null,ps);}}let apexTime=g>0?Math.max(0,vy0/g):0;if(apexTime>flightTime)apexTime=flightTime;const maxHeight=y0+vy0*apexTime-0.5*g*apexTime*apexTime;let optAngleDeg=45;if(g>0&&v0>0){const tanTheta=v0/Math.sqrt(v0*v0+2*g*y0);optAngleDeg=Math.atan(tanTheta)*180/Math.PI;}const times=input.times_s||[];const states=[];for(let i=0;i<times.length;i++){const t=+times[i];let teff=t;if(teff<0)teff=0;if(teff>flightTime)teff=flightTime;const vx=vx0;const vy=vy0-g*teff;const x=x0+vx0*teff;const y=Math.max(0,y0+vy0*teff-0.5*g*teff*teff);const ke=0.5*m*(vx*vx+vy*vy);const pe=m*g*y;states.push({t_s:t,x_m:x,y_m:y,vx_m_s:vx,vy_m_s:vy,ax_m_s2:ax,ay_m_s2:ay,kinetic_j:ke,potential_j:pe,mechanical_j:ke+pe});}return {states:states,events:{flight_time_s:isFinite(flightTime)?flightTime:null,range_m:isFinite(flightTime)?x0+vx0*flightTime:null,apex_time_s:apexTime,max_height_m:maxHeight,optimal_equal_height_angle_deg:optAngleDeg}};}});"}
